pathogen.value: Haemoproteus columbae (a blood parasite related to Plasmodium)

value: transmitted by the pigeon louse fly (Pseudolynchia canariensis)

mortality.value: Usually benign in pigeons and does not reduce survival, but can sometimes be fatal to young pigeons

summary.value: Haemoproteus columbae is a blood parasite that specifically infects pigeons, spread by the pigeon louse fly. It is usually harmless but can occasionally kill young pigeons; the source text does not describe it affecting chickens.
